newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom float boosts trade volume in German shares.
newsitem.headline: Telekom float boosts trade volume in German shares.

text.p: Trade volume on the German stock exchanges rose by 83 percent in November, the month when shares in telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom were first floated, the German stock exchange said on Monday.
German shares with a total value of 249.3 billion marks changed hands, up from 136.2 billion marks for the same month last year.
The most heavily traded stock was Deutsche Telekom, first traded on November 18, with 34.58 billion marks-worth changing hands.
Meanwhile trade in German bonds slipped 19.3 percent to 481.8 billion marks.
The total volume of trade in shares, bonds and derivatives was 1.8 percent lower than last year at 759.7 billion marks.
On the German futures exchange (DTB) total volume rose 37.2 percent to 7.224 billion contracts.
